notes.title: Try Not To Plummet Demo - Now Available!
notes.content: [p]I'm happy to announce the free release of a new [b]Try Not To Plummet Demo[/b] version for anyone interested in giving the game a try! This demo is [b]available for free on Steam right now[/b] on the [b]Try Not To Plummet[/b] store page![/p][p][/p][h1]What is in it?[/h1][p]The demo version of the game includes the following list of features, all of which are also available in the full game of Try Not To Plummet:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Original Beta Level[/b]: The content that was made available as a part of The Original Level Update is now free to play in the demo version of the game! This includes the ability to play though the original beta version of Mt. Cadere! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom Level Editor[/b]: All of the content associated with the custom level editor, custom level player, and custom level importer/exporter are available in full within the demo version of Try Not To Plummet! This direction was chosen so you can play through and share all of your creations with your friends without having to buy the full game - its more fun that way![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]What is the difference to the full game?[/h1][p]The full game of Try Not To Plummet contains all of the content available within the demo version of the game alongside a few distinct major content additions. Most notably, these additions include the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Full Base Game[/b]: Climb the full game release version of Mt. Cadere and test your skills in order to defeat the mountain and return home! Features of this definitive version of Mt. Cadere include:[/p][list][*][p][b]A Taller Mountain[/b]: The full game release version of the mountain is approximately two times taller than the demo version![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Challenges[/b]: The full game release mountain has more platforming challenges as apposed to the beta version available in the demo! Using lasers and difficult platforming the higher up the mountain you climb to truly test your skill![/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Characters[/b]: Friends and foes are scattered across the mountain, here to give you support or pray on your downfall.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Surprises[/b]: I won't explain this one, you'll just have to find out for yourself![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Challenge Modes[/b]: Challenge modes available to be played across all different levels of the game, including the base game, beta level, and all custom made levels! (All toggleable from the Extras menu) These challenge modes currently include the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hardcore[/b]: If you hit your head, bounce, or bonk once on the mountain, you restart![/p][/*][*][p][b]Original Physics[/b]: Play the game with the original physics with less fuel and a more bouncy main character! (This was the original physics before they were nerfed in the beta)[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Challenge Modes[/b]: Play the game with both the Original Physics and Hardcore modes enabled for the most challenging experience![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Achievements[/b]: All of the achievements for the game are available within the full version of the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Hope you enjoy![/h1][p][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues, please contact me at [url="https://uncreditedgame@gmail.com"]uncreditedgame@gmail.com[/url] and I will respond as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy Climbing![/p][p][/p][p]Uncredited[/p]

notes.title: Release Patch 5
notes.content:
Quality of life changes and improvements to the custom level editor and its menus.

[list]
[*] [b]Install Folder Access: [/b]Can now open the custom level install folder from within the game.
[*] [b]Blank Custom Level Generation: [/b]Can now generate a new blank custom level within the game.
[*] [b]Streamlined Menu Access: [/b]The exit button on the custom level in game pause screen now sends you to the custom level editor selection screen rather than the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: The Original Level Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
By popular demand, I am happy to announce the addition of the Original Beta Level of Try Not To Plummet as an additional free content update! Alongside this major content addition, this update comes with 4 new achievements added in relation to the Original Beta Level!

[h1]Original Beta Level[/h1]
In earlier builds of Try Not To Plummet the Original Beta Level was intended to be the main stage of game, though was scrapped in favour of the reworked main level that came with the initial release version of Try Not To Plummet. There were a number of factors that went into deciding this rework, though the major reason was the short length of the Original Beta Level, being half the length of the base game. 

Whilst the overall gameplay experience of the Original Beta Level is quite similar to the base game, I would describe the Beta Level as vastly easier in comparison to the unforgiving nature of the base game's level design. The Original Beta Level having less blind jumps, no lasers, and no hook jumps - if you enjoy the mechanics of the base game but would rather not deal with as much stress while climbing, I would recommend giving the Original Beta Level an attempt. As it is vastly more forgiving, the Beta Level is perfect for both new players and veterans to hone and practice their skills whilst also providing a good challenge for everyone!

[h3][b]The Original Beta Level can be accessed via the Extras Menu, which is available off the Main Menu of the game.[/b][/h3]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
With this content update, there comes 4 new achievements relating to the Original Beta Level, with each pertaining to the 4 different modifier combinations available in the game's Extras menu. These 4 achievements include the following:
[list]
[*] Beat the Beta Level
[*] Beat the Beta Level with Original Physics Enabled
[*] Beat the Beta Level with Hard Mode Enabled (perma death)
[*] Beat the Beta Level with All Custom Modifiers Enabled
[/list]

[h3][b]All major content added in this update can be found within the Extras Menu, which is available off the Main Menu of the game.[/b][/h3]

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please contact me at [url=uncreditedgame@gmail.com]uncreditedgame@gmail.com[/url] and I will respond as soon as possible.

Happy Climbing!

Uncredited

notes.content:
Small adjustments to the level map, level texture fixes, and bugfixes.

[list]
[*][b]Level Adjustments: [/b]Moved blocks around to improve player visibility (at approximately ~50% A.H.).
[*][b]Texture Fix: [/b] Fixed incorrectly textured laser block (at approximately ~90% B.H.).
[*][b]Bug Fixes: [/b] Fixed bug where the credits scrolling would not speed up correctly when fast forward button held.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Patch 1
notes.content:
Within this release patch comes a few small bugfixes, a slight adjustment to the level, and some quality of life changes!

[list]
[*][b]Quality of Life Changes: [/b] The cutscene at the beginning of the game is now skippable (via pressing either START on controller or ESCAPE on keyboard), and players can now see movement/fuel values by pressing F3 in game.
[*][b]Level Adjustments: [/b] Adjusted the fall trajectory of part of the level to not send you to Rat's pit via introduction of a new catch point (at approximately ~65% B.H.).
[*][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Textured an untextured block.
[/list]
